تبتدري (form VIII)
# تَبْتَدِرِي (tabtadirī) /tab.ta.di.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
# تُبْتَدَرِي (tubtadarī) /tub.ta.da.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
